conviction_note: FY26 was pre-released on 2026-09-17 (OP 27.6bn, NP 16.6bn), so the print turns on the first FY27 guide and the dividend. The company guided above its own mid-term path last year, its July FAQ moves Dubai profits into FY27 and reaffirms the FY29 NP target of 50bn, and its two prior full-year prints rose 20.9% and 8.6%. Against that, the September sales were partly pulled forward, the street's 12-month forward EPS of about 1,125 yen already prices roughly +60% growth, the 09-18 revision gap of +8% faded to +3%, and a follow-on equity raise came three weeks after last year's print. That gives a mild lean: p_up 56 on a 6.5% scale. impact_sum (+1.7) sits above the scaled +0.78 because the findings are sized one at a time and the uncertainty about the sign sits in p_up.
bar: FY27 net profit. Street: IFIS analyst 12-month forward EPS of 1,124-1,126 yen (4 analysts, all strong buy, TP 12,900; https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTarget?bcode=3498, 2026-10-02), which is about 26-27.6bn of NP depending on share count. Company path: mid-term plan NP of 50bn in FY29 at about 50% CAGR from 16.5bn, which is about 24.8bn for FY27 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251003/140120251003568410.pdf). The two roughly agree on ~25-27bn, but the street number is derived from a forward PER rather than a published FY27 consensus, so the guidance finding is capped.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed shorts total 7.39% (4 sellers in the baseline, as of 2026-09-29), +0.05pp. The karauri.net per-seller register (https://karauri.net/3498/) shows prime-broker books: Morgan Stanley MUFG 2.09%, Barclays Capital 2.02%, JPM 2.62% (09-25), BNP 0.89%, UBS 0.87%, Mizuho 0.56%. MS (-0.13pp) and UBS (-0.03pp) trimmed slightly on 09-30. A 22bn CB is outstanding (Q3 短信), so part of the short is plausibly a CB-arbitrage hedge rather than a directional bet. That is an inference, and it means less squeeze fuel than 7.4% suggests. The margin ratio is 6.64, so leveraged retail is crowded long. There is no option skew in Japan. priced_lean_pct is +2.41.

findings.finding: The first FY27 guide is the event. The company's own documents lean it to meet or beat the ~25-27bn NP bar: its FY26 initial guide (16.5bn) sat above its own mid-term path (15bn); the 2026-07-06 FAQ says Dubai profits slipped from FY26 into FY27 and that the FY29 50bn NP target will not be revised; Q3 inventory was 89bn against 53bn at FY25-end; and the 10-01 pipeline lists 11 hotel openings in calendar 2027. The offset is that the 09-17 revision credits 'sale timing brought forward' in hotels, so some FY27 profit landed in FY26.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two prior full-year prints carrying a new-year guide moved +20.89% (2024-10-03) and +8.57% (2025-10-03) close to close (Yahoo chart). The FY26 upward revision gapped +8.2% on 2026-09-18 and closed only +3.06%.
findings.why_not_priced: No FY27 company number exists yet. The stock trades at 6.6x the street's 12-month forward EPS and 10.5x FY26, which prices doubt about the guide (rates, dilution) rather than a beat. If the market were sure of an above-path guide, the stock would not have given back most of the 09-18 gap and sat flat at ~7,400-7,500 since.
findings.independence: The mid-term path and the habit of guiding above it are from the FY25 results deck (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251003/140120251003568410.pdf). The 2027 hotel pipeline is from the 2026-10-01 仕入状況 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261001/140120261001544037.pdf). The pull-forward counterweight is from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260917/140120260917538054.pdf. These are separate company documents, but all are the issuer's own.

findings.finding: The dividend is the second item at this print. The FY26 forecast of 165 yen was left unchanged at the 09-17 revision, a 24.4% payout on revised EPS of 676.5. Since FY23 payout has run 23-31%, and DPS rose +41% (FY25) and +37.5% (FY26, split-adjusted). A FY27 dividend guide well above 165 yen, or a small top-up to the FY26 final, is likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The dividend has been raised with every full-year print since FY19 (FY25 deck dividend chart). Those prints moved +20.9% and +8.6%, but on guidance; the dividend's share of the move cannot be separated.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The yield is 2.2%, and a hike in step with ~+50% profit growth is the habit, so most of it is expected. What is not expected is the size. The 2026-07-03 優待 change (hotel vouchers, 'enriched') already shows management courting retail, and the retail register (margin ratio 6.64) reacts to returns.
findings.independence: Payout and DPS history: FY25 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251002/140120251002567451.pdf. 優待 enrichment: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260703587605.pdf

findings.finding: The FY26 actual is pre-released: on 2026-09-17 the company raised FY26 to sales 163.7bn, OP 27.6bn, ordinary profit 25.7bn, NP 16.6bn (from 150/26.5/24.0/16.5). IFIS consensus still reads ordinary profit 24.7bn, so the reported year can only confirm the revision, plus or minus a small rounding beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The revision itself moved the stock +3.06% close to close on 2026-09-18, after an +8.2% open. Kabutan's 09-18 note says consensus had sat at the old plan.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: the stock closed 7,420 on 09-18 and 7,440 on 10-05. Only a landing above the revised figures is left, as happened with FY25's 10.25bn NP, which beat its initial plan.
findings.independence: IFIS consensus page (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report&bcode=3498) shows the stale 24.71bn ordinary-profit consensus beside the 25.7bn company figure.

findings.finding: Prime-broker shorts of ~7.4% (MS, Barclays, JPM, UBS, BNP, Mizuho) were flat to slightly covering into the print (MS -0.13pp, UBS -0.03pp on 09-30). A guide that clears the bar has buy-to-cover behind it, though part of the position is plausibly a hedge against the 22bn CB.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separable. The 2024 full-year print (+20.9%) is consistent with a squeeze, but the register is not on file for that date.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is in the baseline's priced_lean (+2.41, short_squeeze +3.0). It is filed small because the CB-hedge reading, if right, means the sellers do not cover on news.
findings.independence: The JPX register via the baseline positioning block (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). CB outstanding of 22,000m yen is in the Q3 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260702586896.pdf).

outside_window.finding: Dilution overhang. Last year a 34.5bn public offering followed the full-year print by three weeks (stock -15.17% on 2025-10-27). The Q3 balance sheet shows long-term debt up 15.8bn and a 22bn CB, and the company has launched US projects (Miami, Las Vegas, Dallas), a data centre and an M&A strategy. Another raise is plausible but has no date, and if it came it would most likely land after the window.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: FY26 already revised 09-17, so not expected at the print. Returns: a FY27 dividend guide above 165 yen is likely; no buyback history. New-year guide: the main event, FY27 NP bar ~25-27bn (street 12m-forward EPS ~1,125; mid-term path ~24.8bn). Quarter vs its own 進捗率: Q3 cumulative ordinary profit was 27.4% of plan against 52.7% a year earlier, but the Q4 concentration was flagged in the July FAQ and the year was pre-released, so it no longer matters.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Dubai FY26 profits slipping into FY27 (2026-07-06 FAQ) as a separate positive
rejected_candidates.detail: Merged into the FY27 guidance finding; same line, same document.

rejected_candidates.candidate: DBJ equity into the Atsugi dry automated warehouse (2026-09-30)
rejected_candidates.detail: Completion is spring 2029; no FY27 P&L effect is visible in the window.

baseline_tension: Agrees mildly with the positive priced lean (+2.41) and the flat run-up (+1.5% 20d, -3.5% 5d). The strongest positive the release can carry is an above-path FY27 guide plus a sizeable dividend step-up, and I looked for both. The strongest negative is a guide only at the plan path, which the market's 6.6x forward multiple may read as a miss of the street's ~26-27bn, plus the remembered post-print equity raise.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rules 1 and 2 govern negatives built on public series and a negative tilt, and every finding here is positive; open question 3 (a pre-released revision kills the event) is consistent with sizing the FY26 line near 0, which the draft already did
